name: Gift Sets (Kraft)
description: Custom packaged gift set box with a choice of three or six items included. Made from high-end, eco-friendly Kraft corrugated materials, plus a custom printed tray or tissue paper, a custom printed label to seal the box. Gift box can be used as a mailer. BOX & PACKAGING ONLY PRICE.

features: Bleeds Allowed on All Sides on Label and Tray
materials: Package: Gift Box (200# E-flute Kraft Corrugated), Custom Gloss Label, Custom Tray (16pt Cover Stock) or Tissue Paper
printing: Digital: Full color Printing on the Label & Tray
